description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the home screen of an OTT app, displaying various content rails, handling different load states, and navigation.

classes.name: HomeRootScreen
classes.description: Main widget responsible for rendering the home screen, including headers, content rails, and handling load/error/empty states.

classes.name: _HomeLoading
classes.description: Placeholder widget displayed when the home data is loading.

classes.name: _HomeError
classes.description: Widget shown when there is an error loading the home data, providing a retry button.

classes.name: _HomeEmpty
classes.description: Widget displayed when there are no items to show in the home feed.

classes.name: _ContinueWatchingEmpty
classes.description: Placeholder widget shown when there is no 'continue watching' content.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeRootScreen, handling various UI states and content rendering.

methods.name: _formatPosition
methods.description: Helper method to format an integer seconds value into a 'Xm Ys' string.
